name: Early access
description: Everyone in your beta, what they tried and what they said: a public sign-up page with an email code, the next batch ranked by fit with a reason each, invites drafted in your own mailbox, usage from PostHog, one check-in and at most one chase per tester, and their words filed as feedback. Nobody is let in and nothing is sent until a person presses. Brings Mail with it.

early_access_slug.description: Public URL slug for the Early access app, whose sign-up pages are <app address>/<beta> (unique platform-wide; a suffix is added on collision)
